title: Every objective says what done looks like
goal: The video goal and its parts had no written definition of done for five days while the loop built against them. Make sure every goal the loop is working towards now has measurable success criteria.
notes:
Intake detail (the goal as first filed, moved here by triage 2026-09-23): The video epic and all five children had empty success criteria for five days while the loop built against them (fixed for video on 2026-09-23 in the intake window). Other now epics may be the same. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?

Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: Every now epic and child in queue/objectives.json has measurable success criteria a walk or the user can check
The manager prompt's spec, competitor and workflow sections are regenerated whenever the focus changes (write the rule and the check)
Stale objectives retired or restaged, each change recorded as an objectives_updated event

log.note: triage 2026-09-23: goal rewritten in plain language, the old one kept at the top of notes

video-shell.html was deleted on 2026-09-23 (task the-video-mocks-are-the-user-s-again-and-d18-is): it was the loop's own study arguing against tracks. The target is now pages/video.html, the video-*.html walkthroughs and comp-video.html, restored as the user drew them, plus UX-PATTERNS D18 (rewritten: a document with time has tracks). Where this task mentions video-shell, read video.html.

Reproduced why criteria go missing: writeObjectives (the dashboard's Objectives save) rebuilds each epic as id/title/note/stage/children only, so one save erased all 6 success lists (scratch-copy run: 6 before, 0 after). Fixing that first, then a gap check, a generated focus brief for the manager, and criteria for every now epic.

Criteria written for all 10 now epics that had none (unmanned-loop; ui-building, ui-components, ui-layout; icon-svg, icon-grid, icon-vector, icon-animate, icon-export; measure-redline), each drawn from its mock walkthroughs (icon-draw-wt, icon-animate-wt, icon-loop-wt, icon-export-anim-wt, vector-wt, icon-gradient-wt, component-configure-wt, ui-entry-wt, ui-variants, ui-autolayout, redline, capture-wt, next-measure.md Done when). video-editing (focus), ui-building, icon-svg and measure-redline also carry a spec {mocks, competitors, workflow}, so a focus switch between them already has one.

Manager prompt: the hand-written video/redlining mock paths, competitors and workflows are gone; go-loop.sh appends 'queue.mjs focus-brief' (generated from objectives.json every pass: focus success, now sub-epic success, mocks, competitors, workflow, and any gaps first). Rule written in section 4: promote to now = write success in the same edit; change the focus = write its spec in the same edit; objectives-check must print nothing before a pass finishes. go-loop.sh takes effect the next time the loop restarts (zsh -n clean; the rendered prompt was printed and read).

Stale review: no stage changed. Every now epic has had tasks done or open in the last week (ui-layout last done 09-22, icon-grid 09-20). icon-animate's note said video would inherit the icon strip, stale since D18 gave video its own tracks on 09-23: rewritten. epic-uehjr1 retitled from a raw request sentence to its outcome. Six objectives_updated events recorded, each with by/task/change.

Verified: node queue/bin/objectives-drill.mjs 26/26 (it fails on the old queue-lib); objectives-check exit 0 on the real file; a POST of the served tree to the live dashboard's /api/objectives kept 16/16 success lists and identical epics (dev-server reloads queue-lib by mtime, so the fix is live); Scripts/test.sh 9548 tests passed.

left rough: design-system and interaction-foundations are staged next but each holds two p3 tasks. Principle 5 says only now epics may hold open tasks while manager-prompt section 3 allows p3 work on next epics; the two rules disagree. Not filed: nobody using the app notices, and the manager pass owns staging.

left rough: the dashboard's Objectives tab shows neither success lists nor specs and cannot edit them; they survive a save now but are edited in the file. Not filed: the manager pass fills gaps and the check names them.

Every now epic in queue/objectives.json has success criteria (10 written, from their mocks) and the focus carries a spec; saving objectives from the dashboard no longer erases them (queue-lib writeObjectives kept only id/title/note/stage). The manager's spec, competitor and workflow sections are now generated from the focus epic every pass (queue.mjs focus-brief, appended by go-loop.sh), with the rule in manager-prompt section 4 and the check queue.mjs objectives-check. Stale notes fixed, six objectives_updated events. Verified by queue/bin/objectives-drill.mjs (26/26), a live dashboard save round trip, and Scripts/test.sh (9548 passed).
